Bluesky 设置 → Privacy and Security → App: Generated under Bluesky Settings → Privacy and Security → App Passwords, in the form xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. **Do not use your login password**: an app password can be revoked independently and cannot change your password or delete your account
https://bsky.app/... 可直接点开或发进通知: https://bsky.app/... that can be opened directly or sent in a notification
上限 300 个字（按字形算，中文一个字算一个）。链接、#话题、@用户名会自动变: Up to 300 characters (counted by grapheme; each Chinese character counts as one). Links, #hashtags and @mentions automatically become clickable
发一条 Bluesky 帖子：自动识别链接/话题/提及，可带图与链接卡片: Publish a Bluesky post: links/hashtags/mentions are detected automatically, with optional images and a link card
发帖、发帖串、删帖。免费、无审批、无按次计费——是几个公开社交平台里接入成本最低: Post, thread, and delete posts. Free, no approval needed, no per-call charges — one of the lowest-cost public social platforms to integrate with.
只挂在第一条上，最多 4 张: Attached only to the first post, up to 4 images
只能删授权账号自己发的: Can only delete posts made by the authorized account itself
回复时要连同 uri 一起给: Must be supplied together with the uri when replying
回复给（帖子链接或 at:// 地址）: Reply to (post link or at:// address)
填了则整串挂在那条帖子下: If set, the whole thread is attached under that post
填了就是回复。可直接粘 https://bsky.app/profile/xxx: If set, this is a reply. You can paste https://bsky.app/profile/xxx/post/xxx directly
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 bsky.so: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required when the deployment environment cannot reach bsky.social directly
把多段文本发成一串首尾相连的帖子；第一段可带图: Publish several pieces of text as a connected thread of posts; the first post may include images
按发出顺序；中途失败时这里是**已经发出去的那几条**: In sending order; if sending fails partway through, this lists **only the posts already sent**
按顺序与图片对应，给读屏用户看；少给几条不影响发布: Correspond in order to the images, shown to screen-reader users; providing fewer entries does not block publishing
按顺序逐条发出，后一条自动回复前一条。**一条一段**，本操作不替你断句: Sent one by one in order, each post automatically replying to the previous one. **One segment per post** — this operation does not split your text for you
最多 4 张，每张 ≤2MB（Bluesky 的限制）: Up to 4 images, each ≤2MB (a Bluesky limit)
用账号密码换一次会话。ok=false 表示密码被撤销或改了: Exchanges the account and password for a session once. ok=false means the password was revoked or changed
留空则用正文里的第一个链接自动生成卡片；填 -（减号）表示不要卡片: If left empty, a card is generated automatically from the first link in the body; enter - (a hyphen) to omit the card
留空用 https://bsky.social；自建 PDS 才需要改: Leave empty to use https://bsky.social; change this only if you run your own PDS
逗号分隔的 BCP-47 码，如 zh、en。影响别人的语言过滤能否看到你: Comma-separated BCP-47 codes, e.g. zh, en. Affects whether others' language filters show your posts
首条网页链接: Web link of the first post
